name: invalid
code:
import { expect, it } from 'vitest'
it('example', () => { if (Math.random() > 0) expect(1).toBe(1) })

messages.message: Use test.each or assert the complete result outside branches and iteration. [test-behavior-not-implementation]

name: valid
code:
import { expect, it } from 'vitest'
it.each([1, 2])('example %s', value => { expect(value).toBeGreaterThan(0) })
